defect.cause: The fifth player cannot be assigned one of four plots, so the server delays creating leaderstats. The canonical HUD waits for leaderstats before creating any ScreenGui, leaving the player with no queue explanation.
defect.reproduction: Load the canonical HUD with leaderstats initially unavailable; the pinned old HUD calls WaitForChild before constructing any queue notice. The new whole-HUD fixture checks notice visibility during the wait and normal controls after assignment.
defect.scope: Lua whole-HUD mock only; Roblox UI and actual fifth-player experience not observed.

fix: Construct the existing HUD ScreenGui and a visible waiting-for-slot notice before WaitForChild(leaderstats), then hide the notice once leaderstats and status become available. Preserve the existing selection and status UI.
character_impact: No character stats, prices, combat or selection payload changes. A queued fifth player sees a waiting message until assigned a plot.

evidence.main_qa_note: Success on gameplay-identical 6b4fb5b ancestor; current HEAD changes generated status only.

next_action: Run exact-head CI including whole-HUD queue test and pinned negative control; send draft PR to independent REVIEWER. Do not self-merge.
